ja289:1.2: we must live in but one house,
ja289:1.3: I would wish for royal village,
ja289:2.1: My son for a horse and carriage,
ja289:2.3: While the wretched girl Puṇṇikā expects a mortar and pestle.
ja289:3.1: To brahmin a royal village, to brahmini a hundred cows,
ja289:3.3: To your son a horse and carriage,
ja289:3.5: And to this wretched girl Puṇṇikā give a mortar (and pestle).
